idea-plugin.name: Cloudflare D1 Driver
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a Cloudflare D1 driver to the database tools, so you can browse, query and edit a remote D1 database.

Pick Cloudflare D1 when you add a data source, fill in your account ID and database ID, and use a Cloudflare API token with D1 permission as the password. The IDE downloads the open source driver from GitHub the first time you use it.
